A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.
Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), from which day does the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 move from two-yearly to yearly verification?

response.text: {"lookups": ["IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane position 13 verification periodicity two-yearly yearly / gru a ponte IGEA-PRIM 5t posizione 13 verifica periodica biennale annuale", "D.Lgs. 81/2008 Allegato VII verifiche periodiche apparecchi di sollevamento periodicità annuale cave miniere settore estrattivo / Legislative Decree 81/2008 Annex VII periodic inspection lifting equipment annual extractive mining quarries", "articolo 71 comma 11 D.Lgs. 81/2008 attrezzature di lavoro verifiche periodiche decorrenza data applicazione / Article 71(11) Legislative Decree 81/2008 periodic inspection work equipment applies from date entry into force", "EU Machinery Regulation 2023/1230 Annex overhead travelling crane manual periodic inspection interval declared IGEA-PRIM manuale d'uso verifica periodica ogni anno / manuale macchina gru carroponte periodicità verifica"]}
